overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus S-Line 2 Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness experience right in the comfort of your home. Designed for two, this sauna features 7 Maxxus PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels strategically placed to provide soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood, it includes a chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized spa-like atmosphere. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, this sauna is easy to assemble and enhances any wellness routine.
